analysis: Inspect the declared schema, policy labels, repeated-task grouping and missing values before calculating summaries.
Compute descriptive recovery per policy and repeat, plus paired located-minus-resampling differences only where exact episode/repeat keys match.
Preserve every failed or unavailable reproduction claim and distinguish synthetic from live evidence.
Do not treat repeated seeds as independent tasks, run an adaptive significance search, execute upstream code, call a live model, or infer O performance from the source's outcomes.
claim_boundary: This is a retrospective audit of author-released evidence after seeing the paper's reported results, not a held-out test, independent numerical rerun or AGI evidence.
purpose: Assess whether published numerical repair evidence is inspectable and sufficiently scoped to inform a future O method comparison while PR506 CI runs.
selection_basis: The already acknowledged clean_g1 feed revision10 names this paper; the paper names repair_policies.csv as the source of the located-versus-resampling comparison.
